jobs.description:
• Involved in the (bio)-pharmaceutical drug development process of our clients. 

• Responsible for the development of complex LC-MS/MS methods for small molecules, proteins and/or oligonucleotides.  

• Operate & maintain LC-MS/MS and HRMS instrumentation, incl. routine performance checks, calibration and (basic) troubleshooting. You act as a subject matter expert on Mass Spectrometry. 

• Support the introduction, qualification and transfer of new MS technologies and analytical workflows. 

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• You deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards and interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects. 
  
 

• PhD (or Master equivalent by experience) in a scientific field with a strong (technical) focus on mass spectrometry. 

• Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS operation and troubleshooting on high resolution mass spectrometry platforms (ideally combined triple quad MS platforms) is essential. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex analytical investigations, using a systematic root-cause approach to distinguish LC-, MS-, sample- and method-related issues.  

• Experience with a variety of chromatographic separations (e.g. RP-LC, HILIC) and/or nanoflow liquid chromatography is an additional asset. 

• Capable of working to the highest quality standards required to support development, qualification and validation of LC-MS based methods. 

• Proven ability to work in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Excellent organization and communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

As Partnership Manager, you will play a central role in developing and maintaining ESN International's corporate partnerships, ensuring that they create meaningful benefits for international students, volunteers and the organisation. You will manage existing relationships, identify new business opportunities and help strengthen the financial sustainability of ESN International through mission-aligned partnerships.

Working closely with ESN's leadership and internal teams, you will combine relationship management, business development and the implementation of partnership activities.Account Management & Business Relations

• Serve as the main point of contact in all matters related to current partners' concerns and needs, building and strengthening client relationships to achieve long-term partnerships. 
• Maintain accurate client records, keeping track of contractual conditions, commitments and Key Performance Indicators. 
• Work with other internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure ESN's commitments towards partners are being fulfilled. 
• Manage and develop affiliate marketing and direct marketing strategies for ESN and its partners.
 

ESNcard Support & Roll-out of membership benefits

• Support the development of ESNcard.org and ErasmusCareers.org to improve international students' membership experience with the Erasmus Student Network.
• Coordinate the customer support of queries from students related to student offers and membership questions. 
• Maintain ESN's content management system related to student offers and its linked communication channels, to monitor promotion and visibility of corporate partnerships.
• Analyse data on usage and student engagement to assess impact and improve the offer and engagement.
 

Fundraising

• Identify key areas to further develop ESN's business relations connected to international student mobility, and prepare the acquisition of new partnerships in the corporate world
• Identify trends in corporate needs or opportunities in industries like tech, travel, or education; areas aligned with ESN's mission.
• Implement the partnership strategy to foster sustainable fundraising in cooperation with the Treasurer of ESN.
• Develop ESN's capacity to connect with business partners and foundations to offer them a solution for Corporate Social Responsibility. 
• Fundraise to roll out programs that address ESN International, in collaboration with internal teams in other departments to implement impactful initiatives with external stakeholders. 
• Identify potential diversification of ESN's corporate partnership portfolio and engagement of said partners. 
• Preferably a Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
• Experience working in an NGO, membership organisation or student-led organisation.
• Excellent negotiation skills to negotiate high-level commercial partnerships at the European level.
• Ability to manage and coordinate different stakeholder needs.
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both oral and written: capable of leading negotiations and writing marketing copy.
• Great project management skills: budgeting, meeting deadlines and stakeholder management.
• An innovative and structured approach towards upcoming challenges.
• Proactive attitude. Not afraid of proposing changes and taking ownership of full projects and tasks.
• Ability to motivate and influence big networks of volunteers.
• Ability to manage and mentor the Digital Marketing Intern daily.
• Likes to work in teams and feels comfortable in a multicultural environment.
• Knowledge of the following will be highly appreciated:
• Affiliate and Referral marketing
• Social media marketing
• Email marketing
• Google Analytics
• Financial management
• Contract and/or Commercial law
• GDPR and other Data Privacy regulations 
• Full-time position (38 hours per week);
• One-year contract (prolongation depending on external funding);
• Gross monthly salary between €2500 and €2800, corresponding to ESN International's salary framework. Placement within the range will be determined by objective criteria, including relevant professional experience and competencies.
• A 13th month and holiday pay in accordance with the applicable Belgian employment conditions.
• Additional benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and public transport reimbursement.
• Access to further training (congé éducation) during working hours;
• Opportunities for professional development beyond training, such as networking or access to international conferences.
• Casual, friendly work environment;

Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

• 
Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

• 
Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

• 
Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

• 
Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

• 
Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

• 
Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

• 
Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting

Required Qualifications
• 
Master's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

• 
Minimum 3 years of metallurgical laboratory experience, including leading failure analysis investigations (academic and/or industrial/commercial)

• 
Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills suitable for all organizational levels

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• 
Strong computer proficiency and comfort working in a high-volume environment

• 
Demonstrated ability to lead projects and manage priorities

• 
Fluency in English

• 
Pro-active behavior and professional reporting to customers

• 
Excellent problem-solving capability

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Hands-on experience with tools and instrumentation such as: digital photography, saws/cut-off wheels, cleaning equipment, hardness testing, metallographic microscopes, SEM-EDXA, stereomicroscopes, micrometers, sample preparation equipment, and related hand tools

• 
Experience using LabWare LIMS

• 
Knowledge of industrial water treatment processes and experience performing failure analyses tied to industrial water or process systems

• 
General programming knowledge

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

As Key Account Manager, you grow the company's business with industrial customers across Europe. You look after existing customers, and you bring in new ones. You spend a lot of time visiting customers, and you work closely with the logistics and purchasing team at headquarters.
    
• Manage and develop existing key accounts in Europe  
• Winning new customers in the company's current markets and applications  
• Spot and develop new projects with customers, from the first technical conversation through to supply  
• Negotiate prices and terms, keeping the agreed margins in mind  
• Prepare the yearly sales budget, track volumes and margin every month  
• Keep a close eye on the market, competitors and customer needs, and share what you learn with the team 
  
• At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales in the chemical industry; experience in coatings, adhesives, sealants or polymer applications is a strong plus  
• You have built your own network of customers in the industry and can add value from your first day  
• You like developing new business and you are fully hands-on; you get your energy from working with customers  
• You think like an entrepreneur and understand financial figures, because you manage your own budget and margins  
• You are interested in the technical side of the products and can talk about them confidently with buyers and R&D teams  
• You are fluent in English, any other European language is an asset  
• You are happy to travel regularly to customers across Europe

jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance
• Carry out basic technical interventions
• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them
• Check electrical and mechanical components
• Work with motors, sensors and production installations
• Replace or repair technical parts
• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks
• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations
• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly
• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations
During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education
• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field
• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics
• Willing to work in a 2-shift System
• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

Our client is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Junior Associate with a strong interest in the financial sector and an affinity for IT and digital solutions to join its Operations department.
The Operations department consists of approximately 60 colleagues based in Brussels and manages a broad range of services related to banking products and transactions.
These activities include post-trade processing, cash and payment services, portfolio transfers, tax services, income and corporate actions, and account administration.

 
As an Operations – Cash & Payments Junior Associate, you will: 

 
• Process payment and treasury transactions accurately and efficiently, ensuring high-quality data and excellent service to both internal and external clients. 
 
• Perform operational support activities based on scheduled or ad hoc requests, including account closures, interest adjustments, reconciliation as well as investigation and controls on transactions 
 
• Contribute to the development and implementation of new processes and systems, as well as the continuous improvement of existing ones, with the aim of increasing efficiency, complying with new regulations and market standards, and reducing operational risk. 
 
• Proactively follow and integrate operational and procedural changes to keep your knowledge and expertise up to date. 
 
• Participate in knowledge sharing and training, both receiving training from colleagues and sharing your own expertise across the department. 

 
• A Master's degree or equivalent experience, preferably within the financial sector. 
 
• French or Dutch as your main language, combined with a very good command of the other national language and English. 
 
• A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to learn and share knowledge. 
 
• A dynamic, proactive and confident personality.
